scope: One generated minimal Kotlin Android Activity, offline Gradle/AGP built-in Kotlin and debug signing, on an Android 15 ARM64 production device. Standalone Kotlin/JVM and direct SDK Java/Kotlin workflows were verified separately.

device.execution: Non-debuggable validation target on a physical device, guest workloads in isolated workers.

toolchain.native_sdk_tools: Six AArch64 tools from the locked AOSP platform-tools-35.0.2 community build; see scripts/linux-gradle-sdk-lock.json.
toolchain.repository: Offline /opt/maven inside a fresh project; no host Gradle transform cache imported.

agp_export.vm: -Xint, 384 MiB; JDK 17 PlainDatagramSocket for the Gradle lock listener
agp_export.project: Generated on the physical device with no prebuilt guest transform cache
agp_export.timing_scope: Wall-clock interval including guest fixture import, cold build and export. Installer confirmation excluded. Not a general Gradle benchmark.

kotlin_activity.verification: Read the installed base.apk after the earlier installer timeout, matched the test signer name, run-specific marker in DEX and visible TextView.

native_regressions: Unprivileged WSL workspace broker regression suite, zero skipped; includes sendfile, explicit/implicit offsets, aborted/replayed/out-of-order bulk writes and concurrent O_APPEND writes.
Unprivileged WSL network broker suite: 11 groups passed with no FD leak.
Android NDK API 29 ARM64 build and validation APK build passed. Only Android 15 was tested on hardware.
go_tests: go test ./... passed, using the local Go binary with GOPROXY=off.

jdk_socket_close.nio: reader woke with SocketException: Socket closed, but the thread calling close threw Error caused by IOException in NativeThread.signal.
jdk_socket_close.plain_before_socket_options: PlainDatagramSocketImpl.datagramSocketCreate failed with SocketException: Protocol not available.
jdk_socket_close.plain_after_socket_options: Strict test on physical Android 15, 5 passed including imports: real send/receive, a second thread closed the blocked socket without throwing, receive woke with SocketException. Gradle uses -Djdk.net.usePlainDatagramSocketImpl=true with the guest JDK 17.

outcomes: Two runs returned runner_exit_code 139; no faulting address captured for those runs.
Another run reached 25 tasks including Kotlin compilation, then AGP reported AAPT2 daemon startup failed.
gradle_c1.later_fault: A later C1 run with fault diagnostics exited 139 with SIGSEGV/SEGV_ACCERR; instruction and fault address both classified inside the guest arena. Cause not attributed to a particular HotSpot check.

aapt2_daemon.before: In one guest JVM, the AAPT2 compile/link succeeded with no UDP listener. ProcessBuilder.start returned errno 95/EOPNOTSUPP with a bound blocking loopback DatagramSocket.
aapt2_daemon.after: Both configurations started the ARM64 daemon. Each received Ready, compiled and linked resources, closed the daemon and verified binary AndroidManifest.xml and resources.arsc. The parent DatagramSocket exchanged bytes afterwards.
aapt2_daemon.high_fd_case: With 280 open regular files the guest DatagramSocket was FD 285; the same JVM forked AAPT2, compiled and linked a third resource APK, then exchanged UDP in the parent.

compatibility_findings.high_fd: The raw fork child answers prlimit64 for its own RLIMIT_NOFILE. With 280 files held open before creating the UDP listener, JDK 17 obtained the build profile limit and closed surplus FDs before AAPT2 exec.

packaging.before: The complete guest build reached :app:packageDebug; com.android.zipflinger.ZipWriter.transferFrom:82 threw IOException: Function not implemented in ZipSourceEntry.writeTo -> SignedApk.add. Isolated JDK transferTo0 and Zipflinger also failed.
packaging.after_scope: sendfile(71) between regular files owned by the same project broker; explicit and implicit source offsets, real kernel short transfers and EOF. No socket or exported host handle.

zip_short_write.notes: Zipflinger 9.1.1 computed the CRC on the complete BytesSource but issued a single regular file write. The sandbox's 4 KiB write cap corrupted both the input and copied ZIP; the AGP task itself still reported success.

installer_transport.original: Windows adb shell -T with piped binary stdin
installer_transport.corrected: adb push + device-side size and SHA-256 check before pm install-write; session and temporary APK scoped to this run.

interpreter_build_before_adb_fix.first_install_attempt: Before correcting Windows ADB binary transfer, Package Manager rejected its input with INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_NOT_APK. The original exported bytes of this run were not retained.
